tables.name: team
tables.createSql: CREATE TABLE `team` (`id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(80) NOT NULL, `description` mediumtext NOT NULL, `announcement` mediumtext NOT NULL, `ownerId` int NOT NULL, `permissionGroupId` int NOT NULL, `joinPolicy` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approval', `groupChangeLocked` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `archived` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `memberCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `quotaLimit` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '10737418240', `quotaUsed` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `createdAt` datetime NOT NULL, UNIQUE INDEX `IDX_cf461f5b40cf1a2b8876011e1e` (`name`), INDEX `IDX_49a22109d0b97611c07768e37f` (`ownerId`), UNIQUE INDEX `IDX_f8d9a753097a283e7e56bc80b6` (`permissionGroupId`), INDEX `IDX_0daa7e1ac2e097f1f8e2bc6156` (`archived`), PRIMARY KEY (`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB

tables.name: team_resource
